summary.problem_statement:
`textkit.lines.line_range(text, first, last)` is documented as returning lines `first` through `last` inclusive, numbered from 1, but it is off by one:

    >>> from textkit.lines import line_range
    >>> line_range("alpha\nbeta\ngamma", 1, 2)
    ['beta']

Expected: ['alpha', 'beta']

Required behaviour:

- Lines are numbered from 1 and both `first` and `last` are inclusive, so `line_range(text, n, n)` returns exactly line `n`.
- A `last` beyond the end of the text is clamped to the final line.
- Returned lines do not include their line endings (`\n` or `\r\n`).

Must not change: `first < 1` and `last < first` raise `ValueError`, and empty text yields `[]` (see `tests/test_lines.py`).
